source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The archive move puts the unchanged Account Hub recipe under completed/. All checked blobs match. The explicit-path migration test derives its module name from the path below l10n, so callers use the archived path to name that module. This does not prove an external collector excludes it or that the recipe can never run. No migration was executed.
title: Archiving a Fluent recipe preserves its body while changing its module path
